summary: Reproduced the candidate's GLM-5.3-Flash d_tail=0 TileLang layout-inference divide-by-zero on gfx950, preserved its raw-FP8 CUDA routing fixes, and added compile-time d_tail guards plus a cross-vendor GPU numerical regression. The zero-tail test and a nonzero-tail control both execute and match independent one-hot gathered-KV references after the correction.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate focused suite: 10 passed and 2 CUDA numerical tests skipped on ROCm, confirming the review's coverage gap.

tests.command: ROCM_PATH=/opt/rocm PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5c6d287a1360/tilelang-cache /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5c6d287a1360/venv/bin/python -c '<model-shaped d_tail=0 raw-FP8 TileLang probe>' (candidate content before correction)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: q=[1,32,512], kv=[128,1,512], d_v=512 produced d_tail=0 and failed during TileLang LayoutInference with a divide-by-zero before GPU launch.

tests.command: ROCM_PATH=/opt/rocm PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5c6d287a1360/tilelang-cache /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5c6d287a1360/venv/bin/python -c '<otherwise equivalent d_tail=64 raw-FP8 TileLang probe>' (candidate content before correction)
tests.what_was_measured: Independent boundary control: d_tail=64 compiled for gfx950, launched, synchronized, and returned finite BF16 output.
Passing-after regression: the GLM-5.3-Flash zero-tail shape compiled and executed on gfx950, with output matching an independent one-hot gathered-KV reference (1 passed).
Consolidated focused suite after correction: 11 passed, 2 CUDA-only tests skipped; the new cross-vendor numerical regression executed on ROCm.
Passing-after nonzero-tail boundary: compiled and executed on gfx950 with finite BF16 output and exact one-hot gathered-KV reference agreement (relative error 0.0).

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 was used. Before correction, d_tail=0 failed during compilation while d_tail=64 executed. After correction, both zero-tail and nonzero-tail cases compiled and executed; each numerical one-hot comparison was exact.
remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA H20/SM90, so CUDA code generation and execution were not locally verified.
GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable; no full-model serving, semantic-accuracy, speculative-decoding, capacity, multi-GPU, or multi-node run was performed.
No native rebuild was needed because the correction changes TileLang DSL Python and tests only, not FlyDSL C++ or another native extension source.
